A [[Unidentified Iokath species|technologically-advanced species]] '''invaded''' the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that they designated [[test environment JX967A24]], [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The planet's natives surrendered after 28 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].
